netherlands.title: Flag of the Netherlands
desc: - Three horizontal stripes of red, white, and blue, one of the oldest tricolour flags in the world
- The original orange stripe was changed to red in the 17th century
trivia:
- The tricolour represents courage (red), faith (white), and hope (blue)
- The order of colours was officially standardized in 1937
- The Dutch flag was one of the oldest tricolours and influenced many other European flags
